Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا
Translation: All praise is for Allah who has not taken a son

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِيْ الْمُلْكِ
Translation: And has no partner in His dominion

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ
Translation: And has no protector out of weakness
And glorify Him with great glorification
O my provision in my lifetime
O my companion in my difficulty
O my guardian in my blessings
O my helper in my desires
O my success in my needs
O my protector in my absence
O my sufficiency in my solitude
O my companion in my loneliness
You are the One who conceals my faults
So for You is all praise
And You are the One who forgives my mistakes
So for You is all praise
And You are the One who lifts me from my fall
So for You is all praise

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And conceal my faults
And calm my fears
And forgive my mistakes
And pardon my crimes
And overlook my misdeeds
Among the companions of Paradise
The promise of truth which they were promised
